notes.title: Map Map is coming Q2 2026
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777141/9ce56c94d720e469d659fc9e2eca16907a62f42b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello soon-to-be cartographers,  [/p][p]
Actually, the “soon” isn’t far away now! 😲[/p][p][/p][p]Our very first title *Map Map – A Game About Maps* will be released in the [b]second quarter of 2026![/b]🥳🎉[/p][p][/p][p]It’s still too early to announce a smaller release window, but we wanted to share the rough time frame with you. We’re just beyond excited and wanted to share the news! 🤗🔥[/p][p][/p][p]We truly love reading your messages and comments, or chatting with you in person. Your feedback (especially during our playtests) is incredibly helpful and means the world to us 🥰[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support! 🧡🙏 [/p]

[/p][h3]🎮 Gameplay  [/h3][list][*][p]Playtested islands for the new divider tool  [/p][/*][*][p]Even moooore level design 🏝️[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎨 Art  [/h3][list][*][p]Reworked Billie’s facial expressions[/p][/*][*][p]Designed individual cabins for each crew member on the raft
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44777141/e9a3f20dc1a79809096f33ea460283d4637344a7.png"][/img][/p][h3]🖥️ Programming  [/h3][list][*][p]Added images to missions and support for multiple missions at once  [/p][/*][*][p]Built a tool for easier environment design 🌳[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs and issues for the demo update released right before Gamescom 👩‍🔧[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]💬 Other  [/h3][list][*][p]Exhibited [i]Map Map[/i] at Gamescom  [/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Steam demo ✨[/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: Monthly Dev Log #12
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First, let's talk about the most important and exciting thing from last month: [b]We published our very first demo![/b] 🔥​🥳​🎉​[/p][p]We're super grateful for all the great feedback and support we've received! Thank you so much! 🧡​🥰​🙏​[/p][p]
Most of our work was focused on finishing the demo on time, but we also took on a couple of side quests. So here's what we've been up to:[/p][p][/p][h3]
🎮 Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Finished the level design for demo islands 🏝️[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎨 Art[/h3][list][*][p]Created the set dressing for the onboarding islands[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Steam main and demo pages (they’re now ✨ extra pretty! ✨)[/p][/*][*][p]Worked on two new facial expressions for Milo[/p][/*][*][p]Added new custom Discord emotes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🖥️ Programming[/h3][list][*][p]Set up a localization system 🗣️[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented an options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a twitch integration (It’s fun to see many streamers using this with their communities 🤗)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a looot of bugs to prepare for the demo release (thanks to our community for the amazing help with playtesting! 🥰)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎶 Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some sound issues in the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Created a soundtrack for the trailer 🎹🎵[/p][/*][*][p]Recorded the team's singing voices to create even cooler soundtracks (thanks to our sound designer for having so much patience with us, as most of us don’t have any singing experience 😅🥰)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎞️ Other[/h3][list][*][p]Created an onboarding narrative[/p][/*][*][p]Translated the demo into a total of nine languages[/p][/*][*][p]Published a ✨ new trailer ✨ for the demo release (Have you seen it yet?)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="Z3MGthQFyJ4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
We wish everyone a wonderful start to the week! 🥰​🌞​🍦[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.content:
Hello diligent cartographers🗺️ !
We just uploaded a new patch for the demo and these are the things we addressed:

[list]
[*] Fixed getting stuck in the treasure found screen after respawning,
[*] Fixed jump breaking after cancelling step count midair,
[*] Fixed tab captions disappearing in options menu when switching the language,
[*] Fixed flying trees,
[/list]

Thank you for playing and we will keep you updated with further improvements we're adding! ✨

And consider leaving a review on our demo page to share your feedback!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672480/Map_Map__A_Game_About_Maps_Demo/

notes.title: Monthly Dev Log #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

and welcome to our very first Monthly Dev Log! [i]So exciting[/i] 

In order to keep you up to date, we thought that something like a monthly "newsletter" would be great.
So once a month we want to tell you what we've been working on in the last few weeks. If there's anything in particular you're interested in, let us know.
So here is what we worked on the last couple of weeks:

[h2]Art[/h2][list]
    [*]started with ideas and first sketches for a second biome
    [*]created the concept art for a chest and a shovel 
    [*]designed and implemented seagulls
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]  [list]
    [*]recorded new footprint sounds (which are actually live sounds from our workation in Denmark)
[/list]

[h2]Programming[/h2]  [list]
    [*]Setup of a first save system
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]  [list]
    [*]We launched our official Discord community server (if you haven't joined our lovely community yet, head over [url=https://discord.gg/W47cSBnmE7]there[/url])
[/list]

We wish you all a fantastic day!
